scope: Proposition 5.1 (Stability along observations) of the manuscript “A spectral gap throughout the high-temperature Sherrington–Kirkpatrick phase” (preprints/A-spectral-gap-throughout-the-high-temperature-Sherrington-Kirkpatrick-phase-September-24-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 227 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 d1eccdc9781a9cf3), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 27. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix j ∈ (0, 1) and 0 < T < ∞. There are constants η, c, ϵA, ρ0, a > 0, depending only on j, T, and events Jn for the zero-diagonal Gaussian matrix J, such that P(J ∈ Jn) −→ 1 and the following assertion holds for every J ∈ Jn. Let X ∼ µ0, let B0 be an independent standard n-dimensional Brownian motion, and put Y (t) = tX + B0(t). With conditional probability at least 1 − e−an, simultaneously for 0 ≤ t ≤ T, y ∈ Rn, and all diagonal A, ∥FJ,Y (t)(y)∥ ≤ 2ρ0 √ n, 0 ≤ A ≤ (1 + η)I, ∥A − Vy∥F ≤ ϵA √ n ) =⇒ HJ (y, A) ≻ cI. (5.3) We may require j(1 + η)2 < 1 and ∥J∥ ≤ 2 √ j + θ on Jn, for any sufficiently small fixed θ > 0 chosen in the proof.
